headline: Lagarde will leave the ECB early, a drone kills 13 at Dnipro station, and Hong Kong's leader apologises for last year's fire

stories.title: Lagarde will step down as ECB president on Feb 7, months early
facts: The ECB says Christine Lagarde told the Governing Council and European Council President António Costa she'll leave on Feb 7, 2027. Her term ran to the end of October 2027.
Reports say the early exit lets euro leaders pick a successor before France's presidential election in April 2027, where Marine Le Pen is the favourite.

Klaas Knot and Pablo Hernández de Cos are seen as frontrunners, and Bundesbank president Joachim Nagel has also been mentioned. Isabel Schnabel leaves for the IMF in January and Philip Lane's term ends in June 2027.
Costa says the succession procedure starts today. Klingbeil says Germany will bring its weight to bear.
It lands on ECB rate day: the decision is due at 14:15 Berlin and the press conference at 14:45, with rates expected to hold at 2.5% and another hike possible in December.
stories.whyItMatters: The euro area's most powerful economic job opens up while rates may still rise, and several board seats now get negotiated at the same time.

stories.title: A Russian drone hits a train at Dnipro station, killing 13
facts: A jet-powered drone struck the platform where train No. 866 to Zaporizhzhia was standing.
At least 13 people were killed and 13 injured. Four are in grave condition, including an 11-year-old boy.
Four jet drones attacked and three were shot down. People were on the platform despite the air alert.
Zelensky called the attack horrific and demanded international action.
stories.whyItMatters: It's a deadly hit on civilian rail passengers while ceasefire diplomacy is still under way.

image.alt: A paramedic and police officers carry a person injured at a railway station

stories.title: Hong Kong's leader apologises for the Wang Fuk Court fire, and the housing chief quits
facts: John Lee bowed and apologised for the Wang Fuk Court fire in November 2025, which killed 168 people.
Housing secretary Winnie Ho resigned to take political responsibility, though no personal wrongdoing was found.

The government report found fire-retardant scaffold nets were swapped for non-retardant ones and flammable foam boards were used, and it lists failings in four departments, including Buildings and Fire Services.
It also found bid-rigging by triads. Lee says 40 to 50 officers will be investigated, with results in three months; Michael Wong is acting housing secretary.
stories.whyItMatters: It's a rare top-level accountability move in Hong Kong after one of its deadliest fires.

image.alt: A row of Chinese men wearing dark suits and glasses bow in apology, with the focus of the shot centering on John Lee in the middle of the row

stories.title: Report: DeepSeek and Moonshot trained their newest models on OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra
facts: The Information reports that Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro (released last week) and DeepSeek's V4.1-Flash 1017 (Oct 17) relied heavily on outputs from OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra.
None of the companies commented, per Reuters.
OpenAI said on Sept 30 that a July distillation campaign with more than 15,000 users was linked to Moonshot and shut down by July 28.
Anthropic says its anti-distillation measures cut harvesting by 90 to 99%.
stories.whyItMatters: If it holds up, China's newest frontier-class models were partly built from a US lab's outputs, which feeds the export-control fight.

stories.title: Patch now: Chrome 156, Oracle EBS under attack, and an exploited Drupal Commerce hole
facts: Chrome 156.0.8078.73 fixes 52 security bugs, four of them critical. Many were reported by Anthropic's Xinyang Ge with Claude, and several by OpenAI Codex Security.

Oracle E-Business Suite CVE-2026-101767 (CVSS 9.8), an unauthenticated SQL injection leading to code execution in 12.2.3 to 12.2.15, has seen attack attempts since Tuesday, per DefusedCyber via heise. Oracle's October patch update had 1,295 fixes.
Drupal Commerce Core has a highly critical access bypass (CVE-2026-118539) that's being exploited. Update to 3.3.13 or 8.x-2.41 and audit orders.
Broadcom/VMware flags a Node.js Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write (CVE-2026-111497, CVSS 9.8) with only a workaround so far, and Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1.2 fixes a CVSS 9.1 bug.
stories.whyItMatters: Two of these are already being exploited, and AI bug-hunters now find a large share of Chrome's critical flaws.

facts.text: The AfD stored journalists' press-pass data publicly, CORRECTIV reports.
Shell, TotalEnergies and Repsol post higher profits on oil prices driven by the Iran war.
Xi stresses party discipline as China's purges continue, the BBC reports.
Ethiopia received 12 Russian jets as the Tigray war escalates.
Carney is in Montreal for the Canada-EU summit.
Alaska's governor ordered a probe into Mary Peltola's campaign.
South Korea found Apple and Google violated its telecom law, and a Seoul court rejected a refund suit by 88 Tesla FSD owners.
Bayern coach Vincent Kompany was in hospital with meningeal irritation and has been discharged.
In Germany, two people are still missing after a house explosion in Regensburg, and an 8-year-old girl was seriously hurt by a wolf inside a zoo enclosure.
Astronomers found 2026 ED138, a possible dwarf planet up to 1,500 km across.
WIRED tried Snap's $2,195 Specs AR glasses.
BioWare's co-founder spoke out about the cancelled Mass Effect: Universe.
Bun AOT is meant to run existing Bun and Node apps unchanged (eval and node:vm still work); a new PR fixes modules, classes and Workers and upgrades WebKit.
Bun also merged more unsafe-block removals and upgraded to mimalloc 3.6.0 and ICU 79.1.
Amp can now draw visualizations right in the thread.
Svelte skips re-validating branches that were just created offscreen, and TypeScript fixes a signature-help hang.
OpenAI expands partnerships with ServiceNow and with Oracle, whose apps come to ChatGPT.
heise looks at Artificial Analysis Index v5 and its use of more secret benchmarks.
ElevenLabs models are now on Vercel AI Gateway.
Matt Pocock fixed his subagent skill for Codex.
Hugging Face's Reachy Mini robot gets a "Level Up" update.
